CodeTools.designer.title: Designer
CodeTools.designer.description: How the .newui designer looks and behaves

CodeTools.explorer.title: Project Explorer
CodeTools.explorer.description: The C++ project explorer tool window. These settings take effect once the explorer is available

CodeTools.editor.highlightDelayMs.title: Highlight delay (ms)
CodeTools.editor.highlightDelayMs.description: How long typing must pause before syntax colors and folds are recomputed

CodeTools.editor.diagnosticsDelayMs.title: Diagnostics delay (ms)
CodeTools.editor.diagnosticsDelayMs.description: How long typing must pause before the code is parsed again for errors and the outline

CodeTools.editor.wordWrap.title: Word wrap
CodeTools.editor.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways

CodeTools.editor.inactiveNotes.title: Notes on inactive code
CodeTools.editor.inactiveNotes.description: Show a short note, such as "inactive: depends on FEATURE_X", at the end of the first line of code the preprocessor skips

CodeTools.editor.fadeInactive.title: Fade inactive code
CodeTools.editor.fadeInactive.description: Keep the syntax colors in code the preprocessor skips, but fade them toward the background. Off leaves the colors as they are

CodeTools.editor.fadeStrength.title: Inactive code fade (%)
CodeTools.editor.fadeStrength.description: How far the colors of inactive code move toward the background when it is faded, 0 to 100

CodeTools.editor.peekTabWidth.title: Tab width in problem previews
CodeTools.editor.peekTabWidth.description: A tab in a source excerpt is shown as this many columns

CodeTools.designer.toolboxWidth.description: Width of the toolbox pane, in device-independent pixels. Applies to designers opened afterward

CodeTools.designer.propertiesWidth.title: Properties width
CodeTools.designer.propertiesWidth.description: Width of the properties pane, in device-independent pixels. Applies to designers opened afterward

CodeTools.designer.canvasWidth.title: Blank canvas width
CodeTools.designer.canvasWidth.description: Width of the design surface for a new, empty document, in device-independent pixels

CodeTools.designer.newControlWidth.title: New control width
CodeTools.designer.newControlWidth.description: Width of a control dropped from the toolbox, in device-independent pixels

CodeTools.explorer.defaultView.description: The view shown when the explorer opens. Not yet active

CodeTools.explorer.compileCommandsPaths.title: compile_commands.json search paths
CodeTools.explorer.compileCommandsPaths.description: Folders to search for compile_commands.json, relative to the workspace root, separated by semicolons. Not yet active

CodeTools.explorer.dimUnreferenced.title: Dim unreferenced symbols

CodeTools.designer.handleSize.description: Side of the square resize handles on the selected control, in device-independent pixels
